contact.basis: Dry exterior southeast forecourt, exact2m review node; preliminary north-up[22.968062,39.874132]. Separate from roofs, raised courts and kitchen. Chosen before geometry; class2 support verified. Datum is pure vertical translation, no terrain values altered.

verticalDatum: Cascais EPSG5780 per DGT documentation; horizontal PT-TM06/ETRS89 EPSG3763
source: Public DGT July2024 classified airborne LiDAR, class2 only; fixed12-neighbor inverse squared distance derivative
attribution: Direção-Geral do Território (DGT), LiDAR mainland Portugal2024–2025, July2024 source tiles; CC BY4.0
limitations: Original July2024 DGT class2 ground points only; class6 roofs/terraces kept separate and never used as terrain. Public original compressed byte ranges and response headers preserved before geometry; decoded ground coordinates retained without height alteration.

Fixed inverse squared distance interpolation of the12 nearest class2 points in native EPSG3763; no class2 under most palace roofs/courts. Interpolated hidden ground is not a measured subterranean surface. Vertical steps/retaining edges can be smoothed and local isolated/misclassified returns remain possible.

Source public decoder returns Float32XYZ; header scale0.01m and projectedXY Float32 rounding about0.008m. Grid is rounded0.0001m. Datum/coordinate conversion uses GRS80 transverse-Mercator series throughA6 and the normal signed local111320m-per-degree approximation; WGS84/ETRS89 epoch differences not corrected.

Independent terrain fixed before model geometry. No fitting, flattening or edits to match structure. Compatible host field required; default coarse Earth terrain, construction accuracy and precise hidden-ground contact are not certified.
